items.title: Pete Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: me and Sonny was on the band at that time, and Lou Irvin, somebody from Detroit for a while.

ctx.x: Even Shorty Rogers was on it for a while.
Shorty was before Goz even, yeah. Yeah Shorty and Marky Markowitz, me and Sonny was on the band at that time, and Lou Irvin, somebody from Detroit for a while. Gosh.
There was a lot of people. They go in and out, don’t they?
